actions.reason: Supported verbatim by AMZN 10-Q Q1 2024 (filed 2024-05-01, source AMZN-2024Q1, passage P471): 'AWS sales increased 17% in Q1 2024 compared to the comparable prior year period.' GAAP basis, reported_actual.

Conflicted: as stated, $4.8B is misattributed. The 10-Q shows Q1 2023 operating income was $4.8B and Q1 2024 operating income was $15.3B. Correct and resubmit as: 'Amazon Q1 2024 operating income was $15.3 billion, up from $4.8 billion in Q1 2023,' citing AMZN-2024Q1-P482.

No corpus document covers Trainium inference market share; this metric is outside SEC filing scope entirely (not a financial statement line item) and no source, filed or otherwise, was found. Requires a non-SEC, third-party market-share source before any publication; cannot be verified via this tool's corpus at all, regardless of as_of window.

friction: C2 as originally drafted reversed the reported figures (analyst likely transposed prior-year and current-year values); required correction before publication.

C3 requests a product/market-share metric type not covered by SEC-filing-based evidence sources — flag to requester that this tool only verifies claims groundable in primary financial filings, not third-party market research (e.g., analyst estimates on AI chip market share).
final.simulation_limitations: This is a synthetic exercise with no real trading/investment implications.
